sights.n: KIN Sunrise Beach (KINサンライズビーチ海浜公園)
sights.address: 10819-4 Kin, Kin Town, Kunigami District, Okinawa 904-1201, Japan
sights.w: An 800 m long-beach seaside park in Kin, listed by the OCVB film office as a location. It is one of the three official pilgrimage stops for the manga and anime 'Okitsura': one of the series' manhole covers was installed here, and the Kin Bay council ran its Okitsura collaboration campaign from the park's management building. The campaign art shows the heroines eating taco rice, the dish that started in Kin, against this beach.
sights.anime: Okitsura (沖縄で好きになった子が方言すぎてツラすぎる, anime 2025) — official Okitsura manhole + Kan-Kin-Bay council collab campaign site

sights.address: 1633 Kanna, Ginoza Village, Kunigami District, Okinawa 904-1304, Japan
sights.w: A roadside station on Route 329, the first on Okinawa's east coast. It is known for its water-play plaza and giant slide, and an All About 2025 survey ranked it second among Okinawa roadside stations to visit with children. One of the three official Okitsura manhole covers, showing the heroines and Ginoza's mascot Gī-no-kun, was installed here as part of the Kin Bay council's pilgrimage campaign.
sights.k: Okitsura manhole at a family roadside station
sights.anime: Okitsura (沖縄で好きになった子が方言すぎてツラすぎる, anime 2025) — official Okitsura manhole (with Ginoza mascot Gī-no-kun)
